randomSampling: Capture every merged PR returned for June 2019 in each listed repository. Sort each repository by SHA-256(seed:repository:number). Select round-robin in listed repository order until 25. Do not inspect comments or bug labels to select this stratum.
selectionBias: Purposive repository and month selection; seeded pseudo-random sampling within this frame only. No claim of uniform sampling across all 2017-2020 TS/JS history.
sourceScope: Public GitHub GET requests only; raw response objects and request receipts stored under raw/.
admission: No automatic admission. Reconstruct exact review opportunity, assess duplicate families and scope, retain partial truth, and obtain independent confirmations.
partitionPolicy: Unassigned until independently curated. All related PR/root/clone families stay in one partition. Selection identities and truth require curator control before prompt development. No sealed-holdout claim.
